explanation: Retrieval-Augmented Generation searches external knowledge and gives relevant passages to an LLM before it answers.
An AI agent can use an LLM to decide which allowed tool to request next and use the tool result to complete a goal.
The LLM produces a structured tool request, the application runs the Python function, and the result is returned to the LLM.
LangGraph supports stateful agent execution with nodes, edges, checkpoints and optional human approval.
Model Context Protocol standardises how AI applications connect to tools and data exposed by MCP servers.
